snapshot.unit_rule: price per kg = price / pack grams * 1000; 1 ml counts as 1 g

coverage.rule: city_store: a price tied to that city; national_online_only: only one online price list for the country; placeholder: no observation, the placeholder row stands in and its results stay under synthetic/outputs/

price_ratio_2025_prices.definition: country median plant price per kg (all observations of the category) over the state reference unit value (plant_meat: chicken per kg; dairy_alt: milk per litre), both deflated to 2025 with IMF WEO CPI

reference_periods.Pakistan: HIES 2024-25, fiscal-year label (July 2024 to June 2025 assumed): CPI 2024 / 2 + CPI 2025 / 2

reference_unit_values.source: household tables (HCES 2023-24, HIES 2024-25), market purchases only, multiplier-weighted
